title: Update-Magnitude State Redistribution (UM-SRD): A Shut-off Extension of Weighted SRD for Cut-Cell Methods
summary: Berger & Giuliani (2024) developed a provably stable weighted state redistribution (SRD) algorithm for cut-cell meshes. A key limitation of their method is that, although flux redistribution naturally vanishes when updates are small, SRD continuously applies redistribution even when the flux balance is zero, preventing exact steady-state preservation and potentially introducing unnecessary dissipation in smooth regions. This work introduces Update-Magnitude State Redistribution (UM-SRD), which blends the SRD operator with the identity operator via a smooth, locally-defined scalar indicator…
